messages:
priya: Heads-up — handing off coverage for the next 18h. AureliaPay VIP launch on Mon 09:00 UTC (contract SLA: 99.9% uptime, 95th p50 latency <150ms). Primary risk: expected burst after marketing push + data prefetch hitting KV cache. We have a scheduled load test Fri 22:00 UTC hitting ~8k RPS. Please monitor the VIP pool (vip-aurelia) and fallback routes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aurelia-pay-prelaunch

priya: Notes:
- Dedicated pool: vip-aurelia (4xA100 reserved + burst 2xG4)
- Model pinned: rwdx/v1-13b-quant (fallback -> rwdx/v1-13b-8bit)
- Autoscale policy: conservative_threshold=70% GPU
- Known issue: small memory leak in qcache v2 (mitigation patched but not fully validated)

priya: Quick checks before handoff:
1) `rictl ps --pool vip-aurelia`
2) `curl -s https://console.redwood.internal/api/pools/vip-aurelia/status | jq .`
3) Confirm KV cache hit rate > 85% on console

priya: tagging @sara for overnight cover and @tom for weekdays. I'll be on-call until 03:00 UTC then switching to async.

tom: Ack. I can take weekday mornings. Can we bump burst capacity for the 22:00 load test window? Ops says we have spare quotas but need approval.
	sara: I'll be primary overnight. Plan: watch cpu/gpu util, queue length > 20 triggers paging, and latency 95th >300ms triggers escalation. I'll post a short report at 02:30 UTC.

li: Add a metric watch for 'fallback-rate' and 'model-change-errors'. If fallback spikes, redirect traffic to hosted-standard route `route:aurelia/hosted-fallback` and notify customer success.

tom: Approving burst bump for Fri 21:30-23:30 UTC. I'll update the quota change ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-3491

priya: Thanks. Small config FYI — temporary cache TTL increased to 90s in staging for prefetch tests. Reverting after test.

ops-bot: Rotation note — sara now on-call 2026-11-14T00:00:00Z -> 2026-11-14T18:00:00Z (alias: eng-oncall-sara)

sara: Confirmed. I'll keep the zoom open in case CS needs direct handoff: https://zoom.us/j/123456789

priya: Leaving a small checklist in the runbook: add a note under 'post-test actions' to run `rictl cache flush --pool vip-aurelia --preserve-kv false` only after verifying customer session migrations.

li: Who will own post-launch regression evals for quality? I can run the prompt-set suite if someone hands me access to the replay logs.

tom: I'll share replay logs and a short script to sample requests. Will ping in #support if anything customer-facing shows up.

sara: One last thing — if latency stays high but GPUs idle, check for `host-network` congestion (netstat/ifstat). We had that once during ZenithHealth test.

priya: Perfect. If anything critical pops, escalate to eng-sre paging. Otherwise, I'll review the post-test notes tomorrow. :thumbsup:
